definitions.explanation: A person who fishes, especially as a hobby or sport. Distinct from a commercial fisherman; refers specifically to someone engaged in {釣|つ}り (rod-and-line fishing as recreation).

examples.japanese: {川辺|かわべ}に{釣|つ}り{人|びと}が{何人|なんにん}かいた。
examples.english: There were several anglers by the river.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}から{釣|つ}り{人|びと}たちが{堤防|ていぼう}に{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: Anglers have been lined up along the breakwater since early morning.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}のいい{釣|つ}り{人|びと}は{潮|しお}の{流|なが}れを{読|よ}んでポイントを{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: A skilled angler reads the tides and chooses fishing spots accordingly.

notes:
Compound of {釣|つ}り (fishing) + {人|びと} (person). The reading of {人|ひと} shifts to びと in this compound (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{人|びと}が{集|あつ}まる: anglers gather
- {腕|うで}のいい{釣|つ}り{人|びと}: a skilled angler
- {釣|つ}り{人|びと}の{姿|すがた}: figure(s) of anglers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {釣|つ}り{師|し}: angler — emphasizes skill or seriousness; used for enthusiasts
- {漁師|りょうし}: fisherman — professional, commercial fisherman, not recreational
- {太公望|たいこうぼう}: angler (literary/humorous) — refers to a person devoted to fishing as a pastime
